name: Missing Social Insurance No
query:
select
	e.name as "Mã NV / ID:Link/Employee:90",
	e.employee_name as "Họ tên / Name:Data:220",
	e.department as "Bộ phận / Department:Link/Department:200",
	e.date_of_joining as "Ngày vào làm / Joined:Date:110",
	datediff(curdate(), e.date_of_joining) as "Số ngày / Days:Int:90",
	e.custom_national_id_num as "Số CCCD / National ID:Data:150",
	e.cell_number as "Điện thoại / Phone:Data:120"
from `tabEmployee` e
where e.status = 'Active'
	and ifnull(e.social_insurance_no, '') = ''
order by e.date_of_joining desc, e.name desc
